A comb filter is the same sound arriving twice, a hair apart. Some frequencies cancel. Each cancelled one is a notch.
One over twice the gap. Arrivals one millisecond apart: one divided by two thousandths — five hundred hertz.
Five milliseconds. The human ear doesn't hear that as an echo. It hears it as a bad day.
What would you tell someone who wasn't here tonight?
Aim at people, not the ceiling. A commissioning engineer I learned from used to make me write it exactly like that.
